propositions.name: ethereal_medium_fills_space
propositions.statement: There is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies capable of being set in motion.

propositions.name: medium_has_real_density
propositions.statement: The pervading medium has small but real density.

propositions.name: propagation_finite_velocity
propositions.statement: Motion transmitted through the medium propagates with a great but not infinite velocity.

propositions.name: communication_occupies_time
propositions.statement: The communication of motion through the medium is not instantaneous but occupies time.

propositions.name: instant_across_whole_medium
propositions.statement: There is an instant at which the amount of energy in the whole medium is a definite quantity equally divided.

propositions.name: energy_existed_in_medium_before
propositions.statement: The energy that heats the body must have formerly existed in the moving medium before the undulations reached the body.

propositions.name: time_of_transit_defined
propositions.statement: There is a time during which the undulations travel from the source of heat to the body.

propositions.name: body_motion_through_field
propositions.statement: A body has a definite motion through the electromagnetic field which produces electromotive force.

propositions.name: mechanism_subject_to_dynamics
propositions.statement: The mechanism of the medium is subject to the general laws of Dynamics.

propositions.name: two_kinds_of_energy_only
propositions.statement: The medium stores two kinds of energy: actual energy depending on motion of its parts and potential energy of elastic connections.

propositions.name: half_and_half_energy_division
propositions.statement: At any instant half the energy in the whole medium is energy of motion and half is elastic resilience.

propositions.name: parts_of_medium_connected
propositions.statement: The parts of the medium are so connected that the motion of one part depends on the motion of the rest.

propositions.name: magnetic_force_direction_as_axis
propositions.statement: The direction of the magnetic force serves as the axis of a rotation of the ethereal medium.

propositions.name: electrical_velocity_matches_light
propositions.statement: The velocity of propagation from electrical experiments is so nearly that of light that light itself is an electromagnetic disturbance.

propositions.name: ratio_of_units_is_velocity
propositions.statement: The number of electrostatic units of electricity contained in one electromagnetic unit is the velocity of propagation.

propositions.name: refraction_squared_equals_product
propositions.statement: In dense transparent bodies the square of the index of refraction equals the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity.

propositions.name: relative_velocity_well_defined
propositions.statement: The force between two particles depends on their relative velocity, which is treated as a definite quantity.

propositions.name: body_motion_causes_electromotive_force
propositions.statement: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences an electromotive force.

propositions.name: only_transverse_disturbances_propagate
propositions.statement: The only disturbances which can be propagated through a non-conductive field are those transverse to the direction of propagation.

propositions.name: electric_displacement_is_elastic_yielding
propositions.statement: Electric displacement is a kind of elastic yielding to the action of electromotive force.

propositions.name: elasticity_agrees_across_processes
propositions.statement: The elasticity of the medium calculated from rapid luminous vibrations agrees with that found by the slow process of electrical experiments.

propositions.name: energy_alternates_between_forms
propositions.statement: The propagation of undulations consists in the continual transformation of one form of energy into the other alternately.

propositions.name: same_medium_for_light_and_em
propositions.statement: The elastic medium through which the vibrations of light are propagated is the same medium in which the cause of other electromagnetic phenomena is to be sought.

propositions.name: unit_ratio_equals_light_velocity
propositions.statement: The number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit of electricity should be equal to the velocity of light in air or vacuum.

propositions.name: orbit_radius_combines_with_aberration
propositions.statement: The coefficient of aberration and the received value of the radius of the earth's orbit may be combined to yield the velocity of light in the space surrounding the earth.

propositions.name: wave_propagates_same_in_either_direction
propositions.statement: The wave is propagated in either direction through the field with the same value of the velocity V.

propositions.name: only_transverse_vibrations_propagate
propositions.statement: The equations of the electromagnetic field, deduced from purely experimental evidence, show that transversal vibrations only can be propagated.

propositions.name: em_and_optics_give_same_velocity
propositions.statement: Electromagnetic science and optical science both affirm the propagation of transverse vibrations and both give the same velocity of propagation.

propositions.name: specific_inductive_capacity_equals_index_squared
propositions.statement: The Specific Inductive Capacity is equal to the square of the index of refraction divided by the coefficient of magnetic induction.

propositions.name: magnetic_and_elastic_axes_coincide
propositions.statement: In a crystallized medium the axes of magnetic induction coincide in direction with those of electric elasticity.

propositions.name: principal_plane_ray_isotropic_velocity
propositions.statement: In each principal plane of a crystal the ray polarized in that plane has the same velocity in whatever direction in that plane it is propagated.

propositions.name: conduction_transforms_energy_to_heat
propositions.statement: In a conductor, true currents of conduction transform electrical energy into heat, and the undulation is thereby weakened.

propositions.name: gold_transparency_requires_reduced_optical_loss
propositions.statement: The observed transmission of light through gold-leaf cannot be reconciled with the electromagnetic theory unless there is less loss of energy when electromotive forces reverse with the rapidity of the vibrations of light than when they act for sensible times.

propositions.name: magnetization_direction_in_plane_of_wave
propositions.statement: The direction of the magnetization must be in the plane of the wave.

propositions.name: vibrations_countable_per_second
propositions.statement: The electromotive and magnetic forces of light are reversed a definite number of times per second, more than a thousand million million.

propositions.name: energy_half_magnetic_half_electric
propositions.statement: Half of the energy per unit of volume in the light wave consists of magnetic and half of electric energy.

propositions.name: agreement_implies_common_substance
propositions.statement: The agreement of the electromagnetic and optical results shows that light and magnetism are affections of the same substance and that light is an electromagnetic disturbance propagated through the field according to electromagnetic laws.

propositions.name: electromotive_force_from_time_variation
propositions.statement: The electromotive forces in the field are due to the variations either of the electromagnetic or the electrostatic functions, since there is no motion of conductors in the field.

propositions.name: no_evidence_for_density_of_electricity
propositions.statement: There is no evidence as to the density of electricity, and it is not known whether to consider vitreous electricity as a substance or as the absence of a substance.

propositions.name: perfect_dielectric_no_true_conduction
propositions.statement: In a perfect dielectric there is no true conduction, and the currents p prime, q prime, r prime are only variations in the electric displacement.

propositions.name: second_order_aether_wind_effect
propositions.statement: A relative velocity of the aether equal to the earth's orbital velocity would increase the round-trip transmission time by about one hundred-millionth of the whole.

propositions.name: medium_distinct_from_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The medium through which light is propagated is distinct from the transparent gross matter known to us.

propositions.name: energy_resides_in_medium
propositions.statement: The energy of radiation is not transmitted instantaneously but exists for a certain time in the medium during transit.

propositions.name: aether_elasticity_and_density
propositions.statement: The aether possesses elasticity similar to that of a solid body and has a finite density.

propositions.name: substances_do_not_annihilate
propositions.statement: Two bodies put together cannot annihilate each other.

propositions.name: light_is_process_in_substance
propositions.statement: Light is not itself a substance but a process going on in a substance.

propositions.name: phase_defined_at_x_and_t
propositions.statement: The phase of the process is a well-defined function of a distance x from a fixed point and a time t.

propositions.name: interplanetary_space_filled_with_aether
propositions.statement: The interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty but are occupied by a material substance.

propositions.name: aether_velocity_relative_to_solar_system
propositions.statement: The aether has a definite relative velocity with respect to the solar system that can in principle be determined.

propositions.name: direction_of_earths_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: The earth's motion in its orbit has a definite direction in space that a laboratory apparatus can be aligned with.

propositions.name: vector_process_perpendicular_to_ray
propositions.statement: The physical process in the propagation of light is a directed vector quantity at right angles to the ray.

propositions.name: ether_fills_all_space
propositions.statement: A medium called the ether exists, whose vibrations produce the phenomena of heat and light, and which fills all space.

propositions.name: ether_at_rest_earth_moves
propositions.statement: The ether is at rest and the earth is moving through it.

propositions.name: time_required_is_a_quantity
propositions.statement: The time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface is a quantity that has a value depending on direction.

propositions.name: fresnel_drag_in_optical_media
propositions.statement: The ether enclosed in optical media partakes of the motion of these media to an extent depending on their indices of refraction.

propositions.name: air_drag_negligible
propositions.statement: The motion of the ether within the air is a small fraction of the motion of the air itself and will be neglected.

propositions.name: squared_ratio_effect_too_small_without_wavelength
propositions.statement: The difference depending on the square of the ratio of the two velocities is far too small to measure without a wave-length standard.

propositions.name: wavelength_yellow_light_as_standard
propositions.statement: With a wave-length of yellow light as a standard, the quantity — if it exists — is easily measurable.

propositions.name: perpendicular_light_unaffected
propositions.statement: Light that travels in a direction at right angles to the earth's motion is entirely unaffected by that motion.

propositions.name: rotation_lengthens_second_pencil_path
propositions.statement: Revolving the apparatus through 90° brings the second pencil into the direction of the earth's motion so that its path lengthens.

propositions.name: equal_geometric_paths_between_arms
propositions.statement: The distance bc is made equal to bd, and a plate of glass g compensates for the thickness of b, so the two rays traverse equal paths and are in condition to interfere.

propositions.name: earth_orbital_motion_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: Early in April the earth's motion in its orbit coincides roughly in longitude with the estimated direction of the motion of the solar system toward the constellation Hercules.

propositions.name: motions_combine_as_components_with_resultant
propositions.statement: The earth's orbital motion and the sun's motion combine as two components whose resultant has a definite direction.

propositions.name: arm_pointing_east_coincides_with_resultant
propositions.statement: If the apparatus is placed with arms pointing north and east at noon, the arm pointing east coincides with the resultant motion and the other is at right angles.

propositions.name: brass_arms_expand_with_temperature
propositions.statement: The arms are of brass with coefficient of expansion 0.000019 and length about 1000 mm or 1 700 000 wave-lengths, so a temperature difference of one one-hundredth of a degree between arms displaces the fringes three times the sought amount.

propositions.name: temperature_changes_direction_independent
propositions.statement: Changes of temperature are independent of the direction of the arms, so their effect on the fringes can be eliminated.

propositions.name: null_displacement_refutes_stationary_ether
propositions.statement: The absence of any displacement of the interference bands shows the hypothesis of a stationary ether to be incorrect and erroneous.

propositions.name: aberration_previously_required_moving_earth_still_ether
propositions.statement: The hitherto generally accepted explanation of aberration presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the latter remaining at rest.

propositions.name: light_velocity_in_stationary_ether
propositions.statement: V is the velocity of light in the ether supposed stationary.

propositions.name: apparatus_moves_through_resting_ether
propositions.statement: When the ether is at rest and the whole apparatus moves in the direction sc with the velocity of the earth, the directions and distances traversed by the rays are altered.

propositions.name: path_difference_causes_fringe_shift
propositions.statement: A difference between the two paths produces a displacement of the interference fringes that is proportional to the difference.

propositions.name: rigid_apparatus_under_rotation
propositions.statement: The apparatus can be revolved without producing distortion in the geometry of the paths.

propositions.name: wooden_rod_measures_optical_path
propositions.statement: The lengths of the two optical paths can be measured by a light wooden rod reaching diagonally from mirror to mirror.

propositions.name: two_equal_paths_interfere
propositions.statement: When the paths ab and ac are equal, the two rays interfere along ad.

propositions.name: aberration_tangent_equals_ratio
propositions.statement: The tangent of the angle of aberration is the ratio of the velocity of the earth to the velocity of light.

propositions.name: fresnel_partial_ether_drag
propositions.statement: The ether in the interior of a transparent medium is supposed to move with a velocity less than the velocity of the medium in the ratio (n²-1)/n².

propositions.name: ether_passes_through_metals
propositions.statement: The ether can and does pass through metals, though we cannot assume opaque bodies offer free passage.

propositions.name: solar_motion_combines_with_orbital
propositions.statement: The orbital motion of the earth may be combined with the motion of the solar system to yield a resultant velocity through the ether.

propositions.name: displacement_proportional_to_square_velocity
propositions.statement: The displacement of the fringes is proportional to the square of the velocity of the earth relative to the ether.

propositions.name: first_power_measurable_in_principle
propositions.statement: The first power of the relative velocity of the earth with respect to the ether could be measured, if the velocity of light could be measured without returning the ray to its starting point.

propositions.name: ether_exists
propositions.statement: There is an ether.

propositions.name: ether_carried_by_earth_question
propositions.statement: How far the ether is carried along by the earth is an important question with an answer.

propositions.name: bodies_have_motion_relative_to_ether
propositions.statement: Material bodies have a motion relative to the ether.

propositions.name: through_or_across_ether_distinct
propositions.statement: It is a matter for the ether whether a material body is moving through it or across it.

propositions.name: material_bodies_have_length
propositions.statement: Material bodies have a length that can change.

propositions.name: length_changes_with_motion
propositions.statement: The length of material bodies changes according as they are moving through the ether or across it.

propositions.name: length_change_depends_on_v_squared
propositions.statement: The change in length depends on the square of the ratio of the velocity of a body to that of light.

propositions.name: light_has_velocity
propositions.statement: There is a velocity of light.

propositions.name: ratio_of_velocity_to_light_meaningful
propositions.statement: There is a ratio of the velocity of a body to the velocity of light.

propositions.name: electric_forces_affected_by_ether_motion
propositions.statement: Electric forces are affected by the motion of the electrified bodies relative to the ether.

propositions.name: molecular_forces_affected_by_motion
propositions.statement: The molecular forces are affected by the motion of a body relative to the ether.

propositions.name: body_size_from_molecular_forces
propositions.statement: The size of a body alters when the molecular forces are affected by the motion.

propositions.name: length_change_hypothesis_is_unique
propositions.statement: The changing of the length of material bodies is almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile the opposition between the experiments.

propositions.name: MM_result_opposed_other_experiments
propositions.statement: The Michelson and Morley result seems opposed to other experiments showing the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: ether_in_air_carried_inappreciably
propositions.statement: The ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: experiments_on_same_ether
propositions.statement: The Michelson and Morley experiment and the other experiments are on the same ether, so their results can be reconciled by one hypothesis.

propositions.name: earth_has_orbital_velocity
propositions.statement: The earth is moving with an orbital velocity.

propositions.name: earth_has_rotation
propositions.statement: The earth is in rotation with a velocity.

propositions.name: solar_system_has_motion
propositions.statement: The solar system is in motion.

propositions.name: rotation_velocity_adds_to_orbital
propositions.statement: The velocity of the rotation of the earth is added to and subtracted from its orbital velocity.

propositions.name: orbital_velocity_adds_to_solar_motion
propositions.statement: The orbital velocity of the earth is added to and subtracted from the motion of the solar system.

propositions.name: rotation_alternates_diurnally
propositions.statement: The velocity of the rotation of the earth is added to the orbital velocity at some parts of a diurnal period and subtracted at others.

propositions.name: equatorial_parts_relevant
propositions.statement: The equatorial parts of the earth are where the rotation of the earth can be added to and subtracted from the orbital velocity most importantly.

propositions.name: electrometer_can_observe_variation
propositions.statement: A very delicate quadrant electrometer can observe a diurnal and annual variation of attraction.

propositions.name: permanent_electrification_possible
propositions.statement: Bodies can be permanently electrified so that electrical attractions between them can be observed by secular experiments.

propositions.name: secular_experiments_can_observe_variation
propositions.statement: Secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies can observe a variation of attraction due to motion relative to the ether.

propositions.name: aether_continuous_incompressible
propositions.statement: The æther is a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium endowed with inertia and rotational elasticity.

propositions.name: electrons_are_point_singularities
propositions.statement: Electrons exist in the æther as point-singularities or centres of intrinsic strain.

propositions.name: atoms_are_electron_orbits
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion.

propositions.name: spatial_framework_required
propositions.statement: A definite spacial framework, fixed or moving, to which motion is referred is a necessary part of any dynamical theory.

propositions.name: quiescent_aether_is_newtonian_rest
propositions.statement: The spacial framework in absolute rest introduced by Newton is in fact the quiescent underlying æther.

propositions.name: aether_not_dynamics_of_matter
propositions.statement: The æther, not being matter, need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obey another consistent scheme of dynamical laws.

propositions.name: stagnant_aether_reference_frame
propositions.statement: The space of reference is taken fixed with respect to the stagnant æther, and matter has a velocity ( p, q, r ) at each point ( x, y, z ) relative to it.

propositions.name: electrons_carried_on_by_matter
propositions.statement: In a steady state, the electrons constituting electric densities are wholly carried on by the matter through viscous diffusion of momentum.

propositions.name: actual_forms_change_with_motion
propositions.statement: Conductors change their actual forms to a slight extent depending on (v/c)² when they are put in motion.

propositions.name: moving_body_shrunk_by_factor
propositions.statement: A body in uniform motion through the æther is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio 1 − ½v²/c².

propositions.name: electron_orbits_shorter_in_moving_system
propositions.statement: Individual electrons in the moving system describe corresponding parts of their orbits in times shorter, by ε^(−½), than those of the corresponding system at rest.

propositions.name: corresponding_states_persist_at_each_instant
propositions.statement: If two æthereal systems are set free at any instant in corresponding states, they will be in corresponding states at each subsequent instant.

propositions.name: circuital_relations_determine_evolution
propositions.statement: The circuital relations form a differential scheme of the first order which determines step by step the subsequent stages of a system when its initial state is given.

propositions.name: molecule_is_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented.

propositions.name: gravitation_from_electrons
propositions.statement: Gravitation must belong to the electrons, the ultimate constituents of matter, and must be isotropic all round each of them.

propositions.name: steady_state_confines_to_uniform_spiral
propositions.statement: The requirement of a steady state confines the motion of the matter to uniform spiral motion on a definite axis fixed in the æther.

propositions.name: ether_has_definite_motion
propositions.statement: The ether is either stationary or carried along by moving matter, and its motion is a definite matter.

propositions.name: time_of_journey_perfectly_definite
propositions.statement: The time of journey of light along any given path through any kind of material is perfectly definite and independent of the motion of the material.

propositions.name: velocity_of_light_between_plates_definite
propositions.statement: The velocity of light between two plates moving together in their own plane is a definite quantity that could be increased or diminished by the plates' velocity.

propositions.name: galilean_addition_of_light_and_matter
propositions.statement: If the ether were dragged by the moving plates, the velocity of light through the space between them would be increased or diminished by a fraction of the plates' velocity.

propositions.name: bifurcated_beam_in_two_directions
propositions.statement: A beam of light can be bifurcated so its two halves travel in opposite directions round the space between moving disks and be observed to interfere.

propositions.name: ether_may_possess_viscosity
propositions.statement: The ether may possess a trace of something akin to viscosity by which the medium could be got hold of by moving matter.

propositions.name: magnetic_field_may_grip_ether
propositions.statement: A magnetic field carried by moving matter might confer upon it the power of gripping and rotationally carrying the ether.

propositions.name: electric_charge_may_grip_ether
propositions.statement: Electric charge on moving matter might confer upon a material body some power of gripping and rotationally carrying forward the ether in a quasi-viscous manner.

propositions.name: earth_rotation_shifts_bands
propositions.statement: The earth's rotation through a stationary ether would produce a shift of the bands proportional to the area of the interference square.

propositions.name: turntable_rotation_shifts_bands
propositions.statement: Rotating the whole apparatus, telescope, and observer on a turntable through a stationary ether would produce a reversible shift of the bands.

propositions.name: absence_of_shift_implies_no_drag
propositions.statement: Absence of a reversible shift of the bands when moving matter is spun demonstrates that neither electric nor magnetic field enables moving matter to grip and move the ether rotationally.

propositions.name: irrotational_motion_undetectable_by_optics
propositions.statement: Irrotational motion of a single-valued kind in a medium cannot be detected by interference or any other optical experiment.

propositions.name: single_valued_potential_no_ray_effect
propositions.statement: As long as the motion of a medium is characterised by a single-valued potential function, the course of observable rays through it is independent of the motion.
